message: So, picture this: it's a cozy evening, and suddenly the lights go out. I once fumbled around in the dark, tripping over my own shoes while searching for a flashlight that wasn't even charged. It's funny until you realize how handy a little prep can be. The Red Cross has some great tips on how to be ready for those unexpected power outages, turning potential chaos into a calm night with candles and board games instead. Ever had an unexpected blackout moment?
